tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bya rgod gshongs kyi rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi bskang bshags dngos grub 'byung gnas bzhugs so// mnyan yod bya rgod gshongs kyi bstan srung rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi bskang bshags dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ lhag pa'i lha dpal phyag na rdo rje dang / rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gsum/ khyad par 'jam mgon ma ti bi dza pa'i zhabs la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzigs pa sgrib med mdzes pa'i spyan zur g.yos/ /bsnyen sring mi mnga' snyan gsang ut+pal bskyed/ /bsnyel ba mi mnga' thugs rje chen po'i ngang / /lha khyod thugs rje chen pos dgongs su gsol/ /byang phyogs gser gyi ba gam lcang lo nas/ /rnam thos sras khyod btsun mo sras dang bcas/ /sde brgyad gnod sbyin bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang dang rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka'/ /srung ma khyod kyis g.yar dam gang bcas bzhin/ /sum rtsen gnas kyi 'ja' 'od gur khang nas/ /dngos bshams mchod sprin mgron la da tshur byon/ /bai shar ba ṇa ye sa pa ri wa ra e h+ye hi/ zol min yid rab dang ba'i dad pa yis/ /dri zhim na bun 'thibs dang rol mo'i sgra/ /dbyangs snyan rgyal mtshan gdugs dang lhan cig tu/ /spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gdan la bzhugs/ /pad+ma kā ma la satwaṃ/ zhes spyan drangs la/ bshags pa bya ba ni/ tshul bzhin ma bsgrubs mchod gtor dus las g.yel/ /mchod pa'i sprin phung ngan dang 'bags btsogs can/ /khyed thugs 'gal ba'i nyes ltung grib ma'i tshogs/ /chos srung chen po khyod la mthol zhing bshags/ /shākya'i bstan la ngur smrig 'chang ba'i khrims/ /sgo gsum bslab bya khas blangs dam bca' 'khrugs/ /mkhyen ldan dam pa'i thugs kyis khrel gyur na/ /mar gyur 'gro la lhag bsam sems bskyed kyang / /byams dang snying rje nges 'byung chos kyi dben/ /smon 'jug bslab bya 'gal ba'i nyes ltung tshogs/

/chos dang rdo rje'i spun dang dge 'dun sde/ /rtsa rgyud bla ma'i thugs sun phyung ba sogs/ /rig 'dzin sdom pa 'khrugs pa'i nyes ltung tshogs/ /mchog gsum lha dang bla mar skyabs song yang / /ma dad rnyog pa'i rdzing bur log lta'i sbrul/ /dam chos spyi dang 'gal ba'i nyes ltung tshogs/ /dad gshin rdzas kyi dngos po ma zhu'i dug /chos min yid la dran dang dge 'dun dkor/ /chos brgyad log 'tsho spyad pa'i nyes ltung tshogs/ /nye du spun grogs lha srung zhe 'khon dang / /ngo tsha khrel gzhungs phyi thag thung ba sogs/ /'jig rten lugs dang 'gal ba'i nyes ltung tshogs/ /chos sku zhi ba'i ngang du so sor bshags/ /mkha' la na bun lta bur dwangs gyur cig /gzugs sku thugs rje'i ngang du so sor bshags/ /mtsho la rba rlabs lta bur zhi gyur cig /mdor na bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyis/ /mi rigs nyes pa gang byas mgon khyod kyi/ /thugs dbyings dag pa'i zhing du bzod mdzad nas/ /rab dges phyag gis spyi nas drang du gsol/ /de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ 'chi med lha yi btung ja bdud rtsi'i sman/ /yan lag brgyad ldan dri ma med pa'i chab/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i mchod yon gsar pa 'bul/ /rab dge phyag gi pad+mar bzhes su gsol/ /bai shar ba ṇa ye sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra ti ts+tsha ye swāhā/ phun tshogs 'dod rgu'i brjid pa'i za ma tog /'dab stong g.yur za mtshams sprin dwangs pa'i mdog /nam mkha' gang ba'i me tog chun por 'bul/ /mig sman lcang lo'i rgyan du bzhes su gsol/ /bai shar ba ṇa ye sa pa ri wa ra puṣ+paṃ pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ 'chi med yongs 'du'i nags tshal skyengs byed sman/ /ma la ya sogs dpal gyi lo ma'i dri/ /mkha' khyab bdug spos sprin gyi gur khang 'bul/ /rab rno dri 'dzin nam mkhar bzhes su gsol/ /bai shar ba ṇa ye sa pa ri wa ra dhūṣ+paṃ pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ stong gsum snod du rtsi bcud gsar ba'i mtsho/

/dzam+bu'i shing sogs mar me'i snying po sbar/ /phyi nang mun sel mar me'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /rab mdzes spyan sngar 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol/ /bai shar ba ṇa ye sa pa ri wa ra dhi paṃ pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ gang gi mdzes pa zum byed bdud rtsi'i chab/ /bsil ba'i reg ldan snying gi gdung sel sman/ /mkha' khyab dri chab gur gum dri ldan 'bul/ /khyod thugs bzhed pa'i ze'u 'brur bzhes su gsol/ /bai shar ba ṇa ye sa pa ri wa ra gan+dhaṃ pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ dregs ldan chu lha'i lce brgyas ma myangs bcud/ /zag med bde chen kha dog dri ro'i gter/ /mkha' khyab ro ldan zhal zas bdud rtsi 'bul/ /'dzum zhal ro 'dzin tshim phyir bzhes su gsol/ /bai shar ba ṇa ye sa pa ri wa ra ne wi te pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ dri za'i rgyud mnga' 'phrog byed snyan pa'i dbyangs/ /rdza rnga gling bu lha mi'i glu dbyangs sogs/ /mkha' khyab dbyangs bdun rdzogs pa'i rol mor 'bul/ /ut+pal snyan zhabs tshim phyir bzhes su gsol/ /bai shar ba ṇa ye sa pa ri wa ra shap+ta pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ de ltar mchod pa phul nas bskang dngos la/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi sgo nas rim bzhin/ bai/ gling bzhi ri rgyal nyi zla'i rna cha mdzes/ /kun bzang mchod sprin spungs dang lhan cig tu/ /stong gsum mi zad nor gyis gang ba 'dis/ /khyod sku mdzes pa'i dpal gyi thugs dam bskang / /in+d+ra ni la gser gyi pa tra ris/ /rnam bkra dar zab gos dang lhan cig tu/ /'od gsal nor bu 'bar ba'i tshom bu 'dis/ /khyod sku = skyes phran pho mo 'dzum pa'i sa phreng can/ /sna tshogs 'dod dgu'i phyugs dang lhan cig tu/ /rab mdzes rgyan gyis spud pa'i skye 'gro 'dis/ /khyod sku= nor 'dzin mar gad g.yu yi ral pa 'chang / /bcud ldan 'bru tshogs rgod pa'i mgo lcog ldem/ /yid 'ong me tog 'bar ba'i sa 'dzin 'dis/ /khyod sku= mi dbang rin chen bdun dang 'jig rten khams/

/bkra shis dge legs rab grags rdzas mchog brgyad/ /lha mi'i yo byad 'dod yon rnam lnga 'dis/ /khyod sku= bdag sogs 'khor dang bcas la dgra dang bgegs/ /nad rims dus min 'chi sogs lus kyi skyon/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kun zhi nas/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i lang tsho dar bar mdzod/ /bai/ rnga chen rgyud mangs sgra dang tam+bu ra/ /lha bcas dga' ba'i glu dbyangs dril sil sgra/ /sa gsum snyan pa sgrog pa'i rol mo 'dis/ /khyod gsung snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs dam bskang / /bden gsung rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan chos gzhung / /snyan tshig rnam 'gyur ro ldan mkhas pa'i gtam/ /dus gsum rgyal ba dges pa'i rol mo 'dis/ /khyod gsung= bdag sogs 'khor dang bcas la 'gran pa'i sgor/ /mi bsal lhag chad 'khrul sogs ngag gi skyon/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kun zhi nas/ /snyan grags phyogs bcur sgrog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bai/ rnam dag spros bral lta ba yangs pa'i gzhir/ /byams dang snying rje'i lo tog smin pa'i 'bras/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis/ /khyod thugs dges pa chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /dbang dang rim gnyis ye shes phyag rgya ches/ /snang srid bde chen lhan skyes rol pa'i ngang / /bsnyen sgrub las gsum mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis/ /khyod thugs= bdag sogs 'khor dang bcas la skyon dang 'khrul/ /bying rgod yid mi bde sogs sems kyi skyon/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kun zhi nas/ /ci bsam yid bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bai/ g.yul las rnam rgyal mdung dmar rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ /dar dpyangs lhab lhub g.yo bas 'jig rten mdzes/ /ru mtshon nam mkha' gang ba'i mchod sprin 'dis/ /dpag yas yon tan tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / /bdag sogs 'khor bcas mi mthun dgra las rgyal/ /brtan g.yo 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor dbang du bsdus/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i nyer 'tsho yis/

/rmad byung yon tan lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /bai/ khyod gsung bden tshig grub pa'i a mri tas/ /mi mjed 'jig rten khams kyi zas bcud ro/ /mi zad bdud rtsi dam par bsgyur ba 'dis/ /khyod 'phrin mdzad pa bzang po'i thugs dam bskang / /bdag sogs 'khor dang bcas la thos bsam sogs/ /'khor gsum dang ldan bya ba'i mi mthun phyogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kun zhi nas/ /rnam dkar 'phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod/ /bstan skyong sbyin bdag spyi dang bye brag rnams/ /rdo rje'i tshe ldan chab srid dbu rmog btsan/ /bu nor longs spyod dbang thang rgyas pa yis/ /dge legs phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog /de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ /bai/ bya rgod gshongs kyi bstan srung mdung dmar can/ /brtse bas rjes chags pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /bdud dpung tshar gcod mdung dmar rgyal mtshan gyis/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal ngal gsos po la bstod/ /ci bsam 'dod dgu'i dpal ster ne'u les mdzes/ /sa gsum dbang sdud lcags kyus 'gro ba 'dren/ /gdong lnga'i khri la gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol/ /'od yangs tsha bo rnam thos bu la bstod/ /zla med ston pa 'od srung bstan la khyod/ /mkha' lding dbang por gyur tshe mchog gsum la/ /bden pa'i tshig gis skyabs song bslab gzhi bsrungs/ /bstan srung nyan thos chen po khyod la bstod/ /dal 'bab chu bo'i 'gram du zas gtsang bus/ /dam chos bden pa'i sgra las chos kyi mig /rdul bral dri ma med tshe rgyun zhugs zhes/ /chos srung nyan thos chen po khyod la bstod/ /bden pa'i zla bar gyur tshe rin chen gdugs/ /phul las thub dbang rab brnyes sangs rgyas zhes/ /mngon sum lung bstan mi g.yo brgyad pa'i sa/ /mthar phyin rgyal sras chen po khyod la bstod/ /'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud sogs rgyud sde bzhir/ /dbang bskur dam tshig rdo rjes bka' bsgos pa'i/ /rdo rje 'chang chen rgyud sde'i srung ma ru/

/zhal bzhes rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod la bstod/ /rin chen mang zhes rgyal dbang mkhyen brtse'i gter/ /ma rungs 'dul dang 'phongs pa skyob pa'i phyir/ /drang srong rnam mang thos bur sku sprul pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul chos srung che la bstod/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das tshe thub pa'i bkas/ /lnga brgya tha ma'i bstan pa srungs shig ces/ /bka' bsgo zhal gyis bzhes pa'i mdung dmar can/ /bya gshongs gnas kyi bka' srung khyod la bstod/ /de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ chos kun gsal gzigs rgyal ba'i bden tshig dang / /sngags dang phyag rgya rig 'dzin byin rlabs mthu/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pas byin brlabs pa'i/ /bcud ldan bdud rtsi dam pa'i zhal zas 'di/ /rgyal chen rnam sras dbang po'i zhal du 'bul/ /sras bzhi btsun mor bcas pa'i= las mkhan mdung dmar can gyis= blon chen rta bdag brgyad kyi= sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad= stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis= ljongs chen gnas pa bcu drug= yul 'khor skyong ba lnga brgya'i= 'phrog ma bu bcas srin mo'i= nor gter klu chen brgyad kyi= gnod sbyin bye ba 'bum sde'i zhal du= srin po pho nya'i tshogs kyi zhal du= bzhes shig ro gcig tshims par bzhes nas kyang / /bdag sogs gang du mchis pa'i yul ljongs su/ /nad dang 'thab rtsod dbul 'phongs zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe dang bsod nams lo phyugs rgyas par mdzod/ /srid dang longs spyod dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod par mdzod/ /bai/ zhi rgyas dbang gis 'dul bar ma nus pa'i/ /mngon spyod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig /khyod sku rab 'phros mthing nag 'bar ba'i sku/ /'jigs pa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan du gsol/ /steng nas sprul pa'i bya tshogs mkha' la spros/ /mkha' la rgyu ba'i 'byung po sa la phob/ /sha khrag don snying gnod sbyin zhal du stobs/ /rnam shes 'od gsal chos sku'i zhing du drongs/

/bar nas sprul pa'i gnod sbyin sa la spros/ /sa steng rgyu ba'i ma rungs zhags pas chings/ /sha khrag= rnam shes= smad nas sprul pa'i gcan gzan sa 'og spros/ /sa 'og rgyu ba'i gdug can btson du zungs/ /sha khrag= rnam shes= bai/ bya rgod gshongs kyi rnam sras mdung dmar can/ /lha tshig bden pa'i zhal bzhes dran mdzod la/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag mdzad pa'i 'khor lo yis/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan pa yun rings sgrubs/ /mnyan yod dge 'dun 'bum sde'i gzhal med khang / /'dod dgu rnam sras dbang po'i bang mdzod la/ /lung rigs snyan grags ba dan dkar po yis/ /sa gsum 'jig rten khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /ces bya rgod gshongs kyi rnam sras mdung dmar can la bskang bshags kyi rim pa dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'di ni/ don du gnyer ba 'gas bskul ba'i ngor/ shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa na gardzu na sa mu tras/ dpal mnyan yod bya rgod gshongs kyi chos grwa chen por/ stag lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i yar tshes bzang po la sbyar ba bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi bskang bshags/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
